transcription:
Sticky floors and dim lights, another Friday night
My old guitar case open wide for tips that barely hide
The cost of strings and gas to roam
This town I call my home
But every chord I strike feels right
Bathed in this smoky light

They say this ain't a life, it's just a phase
Lost in a million hazy days
But when I see those few who sing along
I know this is where I belong
'Cause I'm playing for the ones who understand
This worn out six string in my hand
From this dive bar stage I cast my plea
Dreaming of a stadium, wild and free
But tonight, it's just you and me
Yeah tonight, it's just you and me

Oh, the crowd is small, but the spirit's bold
A story waiting to unfold
Saw a poster on the wall today
A band I used to play with
Back when we were kids so keen
Now they're on the silver screen
It stings a little, I won't lie
As another lonely hour drifts by
But the rhythm of the kick drum keeps me whole
Feeding this hungry soul

They say this ain't a life, it's just a phase
Lost in a million hazy days
But when I see those few who sing along
I know this is where I belong
'Cause I'm playing for the ones who understand
This worn out six string in my hand
From this dive bar stage I cast my plea
Dreaming of a stadium, wild and free
But tonight, it's just you and me
Yeah tonight, it's just you and me

Maybe tomorrow the stars will align
Maybe this dream will finally be mine
But there's a magic in this humble sound
On this hallowed, grimy ground

'Cause I'm playing for the ones who understand
This worn out six string in my hand
From this dive bar stage I cast my plea
Dreaming of a stadium, wild and free
But tonight, it's just you and me
Yeah tonight, it's just you and me
lyrics:
【Dive Bar Stage / Just You and Me】

Sticky floors and dim lights, another Friday night
My old guitar case open wide, for tips that barely hide
The cost of strings and gas to roam
This town I call my home
But every chord I strike feels right, bathed in this smoky light

They say this ain't a life, it's just a phase
Lost in a million hazy days
But when I see those few who sing along
I know this is where I belong

Cause I'm playing for the ones who understand
This worn-out six-string in my hand
From this dive bar stage, I cast my plea
Dreaming of a stadium wild and free
But tonight, it's just you and me
Yeah tonight, it's just you and me
notes: 轉換與歌詞比對顯示此曲有大量額外橋段。歌詞檔為精簡版本（約1分25秒），而實際演唱包含完整敘事段落（海報往事、孤獨時光、明日星光等原創內容）。Match Score 70反映核心歌詞匹配，但實際演唱內容比歌詞檔多出約80%。強烈建議更新歌詞檔以完整收錄實際演唱版本。
